correctness.rationale: In the language with equality and two named strict total orders, a quantifier-free two-variable formula is a Boolean combination of equality and the four strict quadrants. Rank one permits only nonnested quantification, so the four existence bits determine the pointed one-variable type, and each bit is separately definable. For n>1 the first-order endpoints contribute at most two types. An interior point has nonempty sets of left and right bits, giving nine options, but masks 6 and 9 cannot coexist: whichever comes first, one requires the second point above it and the other requires it below. Thus at most eight interior masks occur; n=1 has only mask 0. At equality the eight interior masks must include the value-minimum and value-maximum masks 10 and 5, so both endpoints have vertical witnesses in each direction, forcing masks 12 and 3. All interior candidates except exactly one of 6 and 9 occur, recovering the two spectra without enumeration. Direct quadrant comparisons give ten distinct masks for the exhibited ten-point witness, and fewer points cannot realize ten types. An independent exhaustive run tested all 3,628,800 permutations of size ten, obtained 164 occurrences of each signature (0xfce8 and 0xfea8), and partitioned the 328 maximizers by the eight coordinate symmetries into ten size-four and 36 size-eight orbits. The eight transformations preserve extremality, but do not identify the names of the orders in the logical result.
residual_risks: The finite replay certifies the specified size-ten census only. The universal bound is analytic and uses the stated uncolored, parameter-free language.

evidence: The same-day separable certificate explicitly lists states 64744 and 65192 with shortest representatives of length ten. These are exactly 0xfce8 and 0xfea8; its quadrant bit order is reversed, and both sets are invariant under that reversal.
That certificate gives the minimum representative length of each reachable separable state and explicit witnesses, not the multiplicities of all size-ten realizations or unrestricted dihedral orbits.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: This is exact table coverage for both masks and their realization, not a coincidental match of the number ten. It does not count all realizations of either state in the full permutation class.

originality.rationale: The four-quadrant logical reduction and even the occurrence of both ten-mask signatures have material coverage in a distinct same-day Resultary record on separable permutations. Neither is credited as separately distinct. The supported contribution is the sharp universal bound on within-structure rank-one diversity over all permutations, together with the census of its unrestricted size-ten extremizers and the symmetry-orbit refinement. The separable classification does not cover arbitrary permutations or give those multiplicities. No equivalent unrestricted bound plus census was substantiated in the bounded comparison; the same-day date does not resolve priority.
residual_risks: The exact same-day signature overlap is documented but relative priority is unresolved. The primary-source reading was targeted, not a whole-document exclusion.

value.rationale: This is the maximum simultaneous local logical diversity in the natural two-order permutation language. The gap between the nine formal interior options and eight compatible ones explains a global obstruction not captured by looking at one point or by counting signature classes. Size ten is the forced minimal equality layer, not an arbitrary enumeration cutoff. Counting and quotienting all its realizations describes the complete equality layer up to geometric symmetries, rather than merely reprinting the two known signature witnesses.
residual_risks: The result does not classify rank-two sentence theories or extremizers of all sizes up to isomorphism.
